automatic: reads established decision; defaultCPU for every category; no production publisher
forced_opencl: Frozen8 if eligible and ready; otherwiseCPU
accounting: disabled by default; when enabled, updates profiles but never establishes a new plan
validation: Every CPU/automatic timed run asserts ready_plan_mask=0,backend_initialization_ns=0,recorded=0,processing_ns=0; exact simulation/output/work counts also compared
limitations: CPU/resource comparisons are end-to-end observations, not learned policy or counterfactual per-request decisions
policy_measurement_limit: GradientObservation records queue/execution/service steady-clock elapsed timings and GPU stage elapsed timings; no per-request thread/process CPU signal. CPU-efficient learned selection is not implemented or demonstrated.
